aboutH2: The Sanctuary Vancouver Island: Private Luxury Treatment on Vancouver Island
intro: The Sanctuary Vancouver Island is an all-inclusive treatment facility that offers highly individualized care to clients. They offer several programs to treat mental health and addiction conditions. Here are some of the programs they offer:
Detox Services: The centre’s detox program is highly individualized and tailored to meet the needs of each client. They offer medically supervised detox in a safe and supportive environment.
Residential Care: The Sanctuary Vancouver Island’s residential care program is designed to provide clients with a safe and comfortable environment for their recovery journey.

Eating Disorders Program: It’s eating disorders program is tailored to meet the unique needs of each client. They provide highly individualized care that focuses on restoring the balance between mind, body, and spirit.
Complex Medical Management: The Sanctuary Vancouver Island’s complex medical management program is designed to provide clients with comprehensive medical care for their underlying conditions.
Family and Couples Counseling: Their family and couples counseling program is designed to help clients rebuild their relationships and improve their communication with loved ones.

pillars.title: A Private House That Is Yours Alone
pillars.body: There is no central campus here. Each client lives in a private residence the centre holds on Vancouver Island, picked from a mix of waterfront, modern and homestead-style homes, and the choice is talked through before admission. The houses carry no sign and no visible link to treatment, and your name is never tied to the property. Unless you bring a family member or partner, the only other people in the house are your support staff. A personal chef cooks every meal, and Sanctuary staff take care of the cleaning and the property itself.

pillars.title: Recovery Coaches and Follow-Up Calls at Home
pillars.body: Aftercare is planned before you go home, and it can happen in your own area or in a supported setting on Vancouver Island. The main option is a recovery coach, usually by phone, for as long or as short a time as you want. The team also sets up regular calls with your Sanctuary therapists and refers you to practitioners near where you live. If you want help with the first days back, the centre can arrange for a carer you already know and trust to travel home with you.

pillars.title: A Medical and Therapy Team Built Around One Person
pillars.body: Everyone is assigned their own team, typically 12 to 15 people, including carers, doctors, nurses, psychotherapists, physiotherapists, massage therapists, yoga teachers and acupuncturists. Medical care is led by Dr. Randal Mason, a family and addiction medicine physician who grew up on Vancouver Island, with psychiatrist Dr. Dan Boston, who has practised in Victoria since 2014. Psychotherapy and case management sit with Dr. Shahar Rabi. The practitioners meet often, and support staff share what they see each day, so the plan can change as you do.

overviewH2: The Sanctuary Vancouver Island: Center Overview
overview: The Sanctuary Vancouver Island is a pioneering residential treatment center that provides a unique approach to helping our clients achieve optimal health and wellness. As part of The Sanctuary World, we are committed to delivering the highest quality care that is private, secure and discreet.

Our treatment experience is designed to cater to the specific requirements and expectations of our VIP clientele. We offer a range of private, luxury medical care, therapeutic retreats, and rehabilitation programs that address a full spectrum of health issues. With an evidence-based approach and integrated teams that have extensive experience in dealing with complexity, we provide solutions for addiction issues, mental health problems, complex medical management and rejuvenation, to general wellness. Our programs include weight loss, post-operative rehabilitation, and general performance enhancement that aim to help our clients regain control of their lives, and shape their future with confidence, contentment, and focus.

At The Sanctuary Vancouver Island, we are dedicated to helping our clients achieve optimum health and happiness. Through our exceptional holistic healthcare, we aim to empower our clients with the ability to live a fulfilling and productive life. Whether it’s overcoming addiction issues, managing mental health conditions, or optimizing physical wellness, we provide the skills, resources, and support that our clients need to achieve their goals.

location.heading: The Sanctuary Vancouver Island on Vancouver Island, British Columbia
location.intro: The Sanctuary does not publish the addresses of its private residences on Vancouver Island, and most clients arrive through Victoria International Airport, where staff can meet them in an unmarked car. From Vancouver, Victoria is about 35 minutes by harbour floatplane or roughly three and a half hours by car with the Tsawwassen to Swartz Bay ferry, and Nanaimo is about an hour and a half's drive north of Victoria.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does The Sanctuary Vancouver Island cost?
faqs.a: recovery.com lists the program at US$225,000 for a stay of 3 weeks or more. The centre's own website does not publish fees; it explains options and program costs during a confidential first call. Because every program is built for one person, ask for a written quote for your plan.

faqs.q: How long does a program last?
faqs.a: There is no fixed length. A senior clinician assesses you by phone first and tells you what can realistically be achieved in a given time, and the plan is fitted to your schedule. recovery.com lists stays starting at 3 weeks.

faqs.q: Does The Sanctuary Vancouver Island offer detox?
faqs.a: Yes. The centre runs a medically supervised Detox Program with doctors and nurses available 24/7, and withdrawal symptoms are monitored and treated with medication as needed. Clients can also complete detox before arriving if that suits them better.

faqs.q: Where is The Sanctuary and how do I get there?
faqs.a: Clients stay in private residences on Vancouver Island whose addresses are not published. Most people fly into Victoria International Airport (YYJ), or into Vancouver International Airport (YVR) and connect to Victoria by plane, helicopter or harbour floatplane. Staff can meet you in an unmarked car, and the centre can even send someone to travel with you.

The team plans aftercare before you go, either at home or in a supported setting on Vancouver Island. Options include a recovery coach, mostly by phone, regular calls with your Sanctuary therapists, referrals to local practitioners and a trusted carer who can travel home with you.

faqs.q: Is this a private, paid centre? Can I use my benefits?
faqs.a: Yes, it is a private, fee-based program and is not part of the publicly funded care run by Island Health. recovery.com lists it as private pay only, and the centre's website says nothing about insurance billing, so check with your insurer and ask the centre about receipts.

faqs.q: What is The Sanctuary Vancouver Island?
faqs.a: The Sanctuary Vancouver Island is a luxury, private therapeutic retreat for high-profile clients.
The Sanctuary Vancouver Island treats addiction and mental health conditions with a holistic approach.

faqs.q: What kind of care do they offer?
faqs.a: The Sanctuary Vancouver Island offers highly individualized care with no group therapy or shared facilities.

faqs.q: What kind of therapies do they offer?
faqs.a: The Sanctuary Vancouver Island offers medical care, psychotherapy, and complementary therapies like bodywork, transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS), brain mapping, and biofeedback therapies.

faqs.q: Can additional modalities be integrated into the program?
faqs.a: Yes, additional modalities like reflexology, osteopathy, dentistry, kinesiology, and pilates can be integrated into the program.

faqs.q: What kind of conditions does The Sanctuary Vancouver Island treat?
faqs.a: The Sanctuary Vancouver Island treats a full spectrum of health conditions including addiction, anxiety, depression, gambling and sex addiction, crypto addiction, relationship difficulties, and gender identity struggles.
Yes, the treatment is highly personalized with hand-crafted therapies and treatments tailored to the unique needs of each individual.
